description: 大阪府の土砂災害警戒区域等データ [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大阪府. 大阪府が指定している土砂災害警戒区域等の範囲、及び名称等のGISデータです。 ※本データの利用にあたっては、ダウンロードしたファイルの中に含まれている「データ利用時の注意事項. txt」ファイルに記載されている事項を必ず確認してください。. Coverage: 大阪府. The portal files it under the publisher 大阪府. Its tags are 災害. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-12-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
